description: This file generates an Excel report from data filtered according to user input, using the vtiger CRM framework. It processes request parameters, creates a report object, applies filters, and outputs the resulting report as an Excel file download.

classes.name: Reports
classes.description: Represents a report within the vtiger system, used here to instantiate report objects based on report ID.

classes.name: ReportRun
classes.description: Handles the execution of report filters and generates the report output, particularly converting report data into Excel format.

methods.name: RunTimeFilter
methods.description: Applies runtime filters to a report based on specified criteria, returning filtered data.

methods.name: writeReportToExcelFile
methods.description: Writes the report data into an Excel file at the specified path.
